$comment: CLIENT CONFIG — the only file (besides brand tokens and the content tree)
a new site edits. Charter §5. Filled for Meridian Generator & Electric.
GOLDEN RULE (charter §1): if a value is true for ONE client only, it lives
here — never hardcoded in an Engine file.
NEVER FABRICATE. `geo`, `rating`, and every *Confirmed flag default to
null/false, and the Engine omits the corresponding output entirely rather
than inventing it. A confirmed-false flag is a real answer; leaving it
unconfirmed is what keeps an unverified claim off the page.
OPEN VERIFY items still unfilled (do not fabricate — ship flagged/withheld):
· site.domain is PROVISIONAL (no live domain chosen). Pre-launch it is a
find/replace + sitemap regen, not a redirect exercise.
· business.hoursSpec is a placeholder (hoursConfirmed:false).
· compliance.licenseNumber is null and licensedClaimAllowed:false until the
license # lands (then flip both).
· business.geo / rating stay null/false (never fabricated).
· GHL endpoint + GTM id are Cloudflare secrets / build vars, not here.

business.name: Meridian Generator & Electric
business.$comment_hours: VERIFY:hours — placeholder Mon–Fri 9–5; hoursConfirmed stays false until the owner confirms real hours, so nothing claims confirmed hours in schema.
$comment_identity: Entity-identity fields for the business JSON-LD node. Each is OMITTED
from the schema when blank/null. `sameAs` cites the business's own
authoritative profiles (GBP, Facebook, BBB) so Google can reconcile this
site with a known entity. Empty until the real GBP export lands.

compliance.$comment_licensed: licensedClaimAllowed stays false until the electrical license # is confirmed (VERIFY:license). The 'authorized Generac dealer / warranty-compliant' claim is a separate, handoff-confirmed brand fact and does not depend on this flag.

claimGates.$comment: Per-client claim gates. Each defaults false; the Engine withholds the claim until confirmed. Generator-specific gates are added in presets/generator (Phase 5) as the lead-form assurances need them.

$comment: Legal-doc + TCPA/A2P posture. Every value is a per-client fact.
`effectiveDate` is a HARDCODED string, never a computed date.
smsConsentRequired = FALSE (OPTIONAL) — owner decision (2026-08-08): keep
the SMS opt-in on the form but do not require it, to avoid form friction.
CONSEQUENCE: the GHL workflow MUST filter on sms_consent === 'yes' before
any SMS action, or the business will text people who never opted in.
legalReviewedBy: setting it non-null removes the draft banner + clears the
lint publish-gate. Owner decision (2026-08-08): accept the placeholder legal
text FOR LAUNCH to drop the banner. IT HAS NOT been reviewed by counsel, so
the value records owner-acceptance, NOT an attorney sign-off. Still send both
docs to counsel; replace this value with the reviewer once they sign off.
a2pBrandRegistered gates turning SMS actions ON in the CRM.
governingState/venueCounty are the business's Indiana / Hamilton County;
counsel confirms the venue at legal review.
legal.legalReviewedBy: Owner-accepted for launch (formal counsel review pending)

site.$comment_domain: VERIFY:domain — PROVISIONAL. No live domain chosen yet. Canonical <link>s, JSON-LD url, and the sitemap all derive from this. No prior indexed site, so swapping it pre-launch is a find/replace + sitemap regen, not a redirect exercise.
site.$comment_timeZone: IANA zone for lead-summary local times. Fishers, IN observes US Eastern.

wordmark.$comment: Two-line lockup used by the starter chrome until Phase 2 replaces it with the logo.css wordmark system. line1 is the identity word; line2 the subline.

brand.$comment_footer: logoMark/footerBlurb/footerLegal/favicon each fall back to a sensible derived default when blank (see src/lib/site.js). primaryCta is the mobile bar's main button.
